voices.subject: cal.definition.definition-pack@1.0.0-candidate.4
voices.text: For one task, the Pack records which concepts the work needs, what can be reused, what is being narrowed or proposed, and what remains unanswered. It keeps the exact sources, context, ownership questions and limits visible so the next person or agent can review the meaning without guessing. A saved Pack preserves what was known then; using it later requires checking what has changed. Task values and results stay inside the Pack. A new working meaning can stay there as an unadmitted proposal; a separate Definition is prepared when its purpose and intended authority scope are explicitly selected.
voices.alignment: Exact meaning and task/value/assessment separation reviewed against formal voice and incident; independent owner fidelity acceptance remains pending.

voices.subject: cal.definition.definition-pack@1.0.0-candidate.4
voices.text: The incident Pack embeds one task-local proposed completeness meaning, its S/A/F/E application, saved synthetic input evidence and a separate coverage assessment. Incident is reused, Work is applied without semantic change, completeness remains proposed and account exclusivity remains open. No per-incident Definition or assessment file is emitted.
voices.alignment: Exact meaning and task/value/assessment separation reviewed against formal voice and incident; independent owner fidelity acceptance remains pending.

voices.subject: cal.definition.cyberalchemy-define@1.0.0-candidate.4
voices.text: Define helps a person or agent establish what the next task depends on: which meanings already apply, what needs a proposal, and which questions remain unanswered. It leaves that work in a reviewable Definition Pack. The Pack covers the concepts explicitly selected for the task; it does not claim to know everything or approve the next action. The Pack keeps task values and any separately produced results together. It prepares a separate Definition only when that materialization is explicitly selected.
voices.alignment: Exact meaning and task/value/assessment separation reviewed against formal voice and incident; independent owner fidelity acceptance remains pending.
